data.name: NUNBORA: Frostblind
data.detailed_description:
The abyss 3km beneath the ice—where silence is your only shield against death.

'NUNBORA: Frostblind' is a 3D 4-player co-op PvE extraction shooter set in an isolated arctic underground research facility.

Following a catastrophic drilling accident by 'Snowdrop Industries (SDI)', a futuristic energy exploration corporation, ancient predators frozen for tens of thousands of years have awakened 3 kilometers beneath the Greenland ice sheet. Players step into the shoes of workers struggling to survive, exploring the pitch-black darkness and blinding blizzards. Evade the horrific threat of these ancient creatures, secure vital resources, and safely extract back to the survival bunker with your team.

Key Features

🤫 Extreme Tension: Silence or Death

The predators of this abyss are extremely sensitive to sound. Every action you take—walking, sprinting, scavenging, or mining—is translated into real-time decibel (dB) levels. The moment your noise exceeds a certain threshold, you and your teammates instantly become targets for the ravenous monsters. Every second demands a choice: move in absolute stealth, or risk it all and sprint with your hard-earned resources.

🤝 Strategy-Driven Co-op PvE Extraction

Leave behind the high-stress encounters of PvP and the anxiety of being looted by other players. This game is designed purely for cooperative PvE teamwork. Appointing bait to distract predators, securing safe extraction routes, and watching each other's backs are the only keys to survival.

🗺️ An Ever-Changing, Unforgiving Environment

The world outside the safe zone never becomes familiar. Every expedition features a procedurally generated map where the layout, resource distribution, and monster spawn points are completely randomized. Even during repeated playthroughs, new crises await, delivering fresh tension with every match.

🎭 A Striking Visual Contrast of Cute and Grotesque

Experience a powerful visual juxtaposition between the cute, charming player characters resiliently surviving the harsh environment, and the spine-chilling, grotesque ancient predators they face. This unique art style blends seamlessly with a cold, neon-glow UI to deliver a fresh yet terrifyingly immersive atmosphere.

Can you survive and escape the deepest, coldest grave on Earth?
